title: LotKeys Info
summary: The V0.9.4.74 team-test build is ready for leaderboard, placeholder, celebration and Posting Buddy testing.

blocks.text: Top Contributors now shows every normal score, with tiny values above their bar and private admin-approved points stacked in gold for administrators without changing the live public order. Missing vehicles use the optimized shared placeholder, month-end scores clear Profile photos, and the existing celebration now includes a slower fading streamer layer. Posting Buddy V0.1.16 adds persistent posting-time and time-saved milestones.
